Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all distinct molecules mentioned in the specified document. Only include molecules that have a canonical SMILES available. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by the document ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures as an inner join on molregno to enforce SMILES availability. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
